## Polling averages update

All numbers are as of 9:30 AM Eastern on Aug. 28, 2026.

### 2026 U.S. House generic ballot

The Democratic margin in the 2026 U.S. House generic ballot remained stable this week, with Democrats ahead of Republicans by 6 percentage points. Currently, 49.5 percent of likely voters indicate that they plan to vote for a Democrat in November, while 43.4 percent plan to vote for a Republican.
